Joshua

Introduction

The Huswi document (LIT reading), it is a story of the descendants of Israil on their attacking of Kanaan. And the (one who) led them was Huswi who replaced Muwisis. These were the happenings in this document (LIT reading): their crossing of the Hurdan River, the destruction of Hiriku, the war there in Ay, the dividing of the place there to the each descendant of Israil, and the redoing of the agreement of God (MS Manama) and his people. And the verse that's very known in this document (LIT reading) is the, “Choose(pl) today whoever you(pl) serve… But me and my family will_serve on_the_contrary with the Lord God” (24:15).

What's written(pl) in this document (LIT reading)

The defeat of Kanaanons \ior 1:1–12:24\ior*

The dividing of land \ior 13:1–21:45\ior*

a. The land there on the east of Hurdan \ior 13:1-33\ior*

b. The land there on the west of Hurdan \ior 14:1–19:51\ior*

c. The cities that are a refuge_place \ior 20:1-9\ior*

d. The cities of the Libitas \ior 21:1-45\ior*

The returning_home by the descendants who were_there in the east, to their places \ior 22:1‑34\ior*

The final speaking by Huswi \ior 23:1‑16\ior*

The redoing of the agreement there at Sikim \ior 24:1‑33\ior*

24 And the people answered, “We(excl) will_serve the Lord our(excl) God, and we(excl) will_obey his commands.”

25 Therefore, on that day Huswi made a covenant there in Sikim for the people of Israil. And he gave them laws and commands. 26 Huswi wrote it there in the Book of Law of God. Then, he took a big stone and put it there near the uk tree there in the holy place of the Lord God. 27 And Huswi told all the people, “This stone will_help you(pl) that you(pl) remember what we(incl) said(pl) today. This stone was here when I told you(pl) the word of the Lord God. Therefore this stone will_help you(pl) that you(pl) remember what happened today. This remind you(pl) to not turning_back (against) God.” 28 Then, Huswi caused_ the people _to_go_home there on their each places as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind).

The dying of Huswi and Ilyasar

29 Then, the servant of the Lord God Huswi the child of Nun died, when his age was one hundred ten (110). 30 [xr]And they buried him there in his portion of the land/place at Timnat-Sira which was there in the mountain of Ipraim, there north (LIT left side) of the mountain of Gaas.

31 The descendants of Israil served the Lord God while Huswi was still alive and the leaders of Israil knew everything that the Lord did for Israil.

32 [xr]The_story_can_be_changed_this time, the bones of Husi that the descendants of Israil brought from Ihiptu, they buried it there in Sikim. The buried it there in the place that Hakub bought for one hundred (100) silver from the children of Hamur the father of Sikim. And the ones who possessed this place were the descendants of Husi.

33 And Ilyasar the child of Aarun also died, and he was_buried there in Gibiya, the city on the mountain of Ipraim that he gave to his child Pinihas.
